semantic_annotation.raw_agreement: six-label confusion matrix and Cohen kappa on paired completed judgments; report full coverage and undefined constant-marginal kappa as null
semantic_annotation.argument_maps: exact permutation agreement among pairs both judged equivalent or permuted-equivalent
semantic_annotation.missing: unreviewed/missing judgments excluded from paired denominator, retained in coverage; uncertain is retained as a substantive label
semantic_annotation.adjudication: preserve both original files; third decision in separate versioned file; disagreements and uncertainty remain visible
semantic_annotation.independence_limit: distinct IDs and declarations do not establish actual independence
semantic_annotation.population_limit: current stratified 100-pair sample is not an unweighted prevalence estimate; different-arity pairs are outside scope

prospective_source_admission: Record upstream project, author, release/commit, original representation, usage attribution and exact file hashes before method development on the candidate.
Record learner/training provenance when learned; use explicit unknowns otherwise and avoid claims about learned-model generalization.
Check overlap with observed 15 stories and other candidate families; freeze source-family split before observing model predictions or solver outcomes.
Freeze explicit worlds, objects/memberships and goals independently of model success; keep initial-only and goal-directed conditions separate.
Preserve all supported semantics during translation; intentional, epistemic, numeric or temporal features cannot silently be removed and still claimed preserved.
Any inspected case used to modify the method becomes development; create a fresh untouched evaluation partition for subsequent test claims.
Predefine candidate universe, all inclusion/exclusion rules, paired solver wall/memory budgets, model digest/prompt/seed settings and required ablations.
Report every frozen task including invalid outputs, parse failures, uncertain judgments, unsolvable tasks and resource cutoffs.
unresolved_before_independent_evaluation: frozen test task and label set
analysis weighting/uncertainty protocol suited to source-family dependencies
no_claims: No semantic accuracy score without independent judged references
No narrative-quality claim from plan validity
No independent-domain generalization from known-source variants
